task.title: Configure metrics for workload availability operators
task.shortdesc: You can use the Red Hat OpenShift web console to install the Node Health Check (NHC) Operator.

context.p: After installing the NHC Operator, Platform Prometheus metrics are automatically configured and ready to use.

step.cmd: The NHC Operator’s namespace is labeled with openshift.io/cluster-monitoring: "true" for Platform Prometheus discovery, and
A ServiceMonitor is deployed to enable TLS client certificate authentication scrapeClass: tls-client-certificate-auth.

result.p: To verify that the setup is complete, check the Prometheus targets by using the Observe > Targets tab in the OCP Web UI.
The NHC target shows UP (in green) within a few minutes of installation. Metric queries are now available for use.
